title: solidago virgaurea subsp. taurica
intro: Solidago virgaurea subsp. taurica, commonly known as Golden Rod, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Solidago virgaurea subsp. taurica include its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
